verdict.stance: Constructive / e&-Backed CEE Telecom Leader Post-Carveout (BBB / Baa2)
verdict.summary: e& PPF Telecom Group (50%+1 share controlled by UAE's e&) operates Yettel/O2 mobile & CETIN telecom infrastructure across Bulgaria, Hungary, Serbia, and Slovakia, generating €2.41bn FY25 revenue and €1.15bn EBITDA. Double-digit H126 growth (boosted by UPC Slovakia & SBB), refreshed Mar-26 EMTN prospectus, and e& sponsorship underpin BBB/Baa2 IG ratings.

positives: High ~44%-48% EBITDA margin across #1/#2 CEE mobile & infrastructure (CETIN) positions.
Strong strategic sponsorship from UAE's e& (AA-rated parent) following 50%+1 controlling acquisition.
Clean maturity profile after repaying €550m Mar-26 notes; Sep-27 €500m XS2238777374 well covered.
negatives: Elevated €702m FY25 capex (5G/fiber rollouts) and M&A integration (UPC Slovakia, SBB).
Structural carve-out complexity between e& PPF Telecom and standalone Czech PPF Telecom Holdings.
Regional CEE FX (HUF, RSD, BGN) and competitive pricing pressures.

background.business_overview: Multi-country CEE telecommunications and network infrastructure operator (Yettel, O2 Slovakia, CETIN).
background.asset_perimeter: Operations in Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia, and Slovakia (carved out from Czech O2/CETIN).
background.ownership_governance: e& (50%+1 controlling stake) and PPF Group (49.9%).

recent_drivers: FY25: Revenue €2.41bn, EBITDA €1.15bn, capex €702m; €550m Mar-26 notes (XS1969645255) matured and repaid.
H126: Double-digit YoY revenue/EBITDA growth from UPC Slovakia & SBB acquisitions; EMTN prospectus refreshed Mar-26.
